resources.string: Adjustment range and available seats depend on the installed hardware. Stop an adjustment if an occupant or object could be trapped.
The selected seat or steering actuator must be powered and report a valid position. Position changes are allowed only while the vehicle UX policy is unrestricted.
This vehicle exposes no supported seat or steering controls.
Park the vehicle to adjust this control.
Live seat position diagram based on observed vehicle position properties

string-array.name: seat_control_descriptions
string-array.item: Moves the selected seat closer to or farther from the pedals.
Raises or lowers the selected seat.
Changes the supported length of the seat cushion.
Tilts the seat cushion while keeping occupants clear of moving parts.
Adjusts the main backrest recline angle.
Adjusts the secondary articulated backrest section when fitted.
Moves lumbar support forward or backward.
Moves lumbar support up or down.
Changes side support around the lower back.
Changes side bolstering on the seat cushion.
Raises or lowers the head restraint.
Moves the head restraint forward or backward.
Moves the seat for easier entry or exit when vehicle conditions permit.
Reports whether the selected seat is vacant or occupied.
Reports the buckle state for the selected seat.
Recalls the selected stored seat position slot.
Saves current supported positions into the selected memory slot.
Moves the steering wheel closer to or farther from the driver.
Raises or lowers the steering wheel.
